I don't know of any such flag. The retrieved documents don't mention an `ollama pull` flag for the number of parallel layer downloads.

The CLI docs only show the bare command: "ollama pull gemma4" [ollama/docs/cli.md]

The API docs list only `model`, `insecure` and `stream` as parameters for pulling. They say "The number of files to be downloaded depends on the number of layers specified in the manifest." [ollama/docs/api.md]. That describes how many files are downloaded, not a way to control concurrency.

The excerpts may not be the full documentation, so I can't rule out that such a flag exists. `ollama pull --help` will list the flags your installed version supports.
